hooks.logic:
Set the next state to 0.
Let v be the register's 'bomCount' or 0.
If v is at least 4, then set the next state to 12 and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "big_bomber" on the enemy, then
    Set the next state to 21.
    Set the register's 'bomCount' to v plus 1 and stop.
  The enemy uses ability.
